researchQuestion: Does source-fenced causal trajectory lineage improve a fresh finite consumer's next prerequisite/blocker/reopen judgment relative to terminal-only historical compression, and can a compact reachability-transition projection preserve that benefit without adding historical facts?

programme.HR0: derive source-fenced reachability-transition projections from existing HD source-native trajectories; no new historical facts
programme.HR2: RAW_LINEAGE vs TRANSITION_PROJECTION same-fact representation test after HR0
programme.HR4: historical transition chain vs 2026 civilization carrier substitution analysis

claimCeiling: HR1 can establish a bounded fresh-consumer information/representation effect on the frozen historical cases; it cannot establish universal historical-reachability competence.
Historical source packets do not establish current Ordivon capability or current owner truth.
Provider answers are experimental observations, not semantic authority.
A CAUSAL_LINEAGE advantage would support preserving some transition information for this query class, not raw transcript retention or a new Atlas schema.
A null result would count against default exposure of historical reachability lineage on similarly bounded tasks.
antiLeakage: Cases test source-grounded reachability judgments, not authentic historical rediscovery.
No claim depends on the model forgetting famous historical outcomes.
Oracle actions are frozen from the source-native trajectory reconstruction before live runs.
